dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Haha, don't tease me. Do you need anything? Or have you been thinking about "Airborne Asha" all this time?

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Whether it be admiring the scenery or creating a new masterpiece, if you want to experience it again, I can take you up in the hot air balloon.
